DevicesMFE.summary: DevicesMFE is a page object class for HP Smart Devices MFE (Micro Frontend) that extends SmartFlow. Implements the Page Object Model pattern with separation of verification and action flows. Key features: string-based locator references, consistent element synchronization, JavaScript executor for non-displayed elements, keyboard interaction for page refresh, multi-screen popup navigation, Windows dummy printer workaround, flexible timeout and exception handling, text retrieval for popup validation, and support for visible/invisible element state verification.
